required_fields: Clinical phenotypes reported in individuals with TAF4-related autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 73 (OMIM #620450)
Frequencies for each phenotype expressed as numerator and denominator per cohort (not percentage alone)
Phenotype descriptions using the paper's original wording plus standard HPO terms where identifiable
PMID or DOI identifying the source paper and specific cohort for each reported phenotype frequency
Most discriminating clinical findings (frequent in affected individuals but uncommon in phenotypically overlapping/confused disorders)
Names of the differential disorders usually confused with this condition
Confidence level of the distinction between this condition and the confused disorders based on discriminating findings
Clinical findings systematically assessed and found absent in affected individuals (findings that argue against the diagnosis)
Phenotype differences correlated with variant type, variant position, patient age, or patient sex
Any findings where reports across papers explicitly contradict one another
